name: Gladocephaloideus
isnote: Placed in Gallodactylidae in 2012; a second skeleton (2016) shows it is a ctenochasmatid close to Pterofiltrus.
sum: Sword-headed ctenochasmatid from the Early Cretaceous (Aptian) of western Liaoning, China.
holotype: IG-CAGS-08-07 — Jingangshan Bed, Yixian Formation (early Aptian), western Liaoning.
material: Almost complete skull (18 cm), lower jaws, front neck vertebrae and part of a hindlimb; juvenile skeleton JPM 2014–004 almost complete.
exceptional: Short pycnofibres preserved at the back of the skull and neck.
biology: About fifty sharp teeth restricted to the front quarter of the jaws; both known individuals are juveniles.
author: Lü et al. 2012
